edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with owner() inside the onlyOwner modifier, so the caller identity gates privileged functions
msg.sender is passed as the initial owner through _setOwner in the constructor
releaseStartTime_ feeds the modulo/rounding arithmetic in the constructor
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to compute _releaseEndTime
totalBenefit_ is stored as the benefit baseline used by later arithmetic
token_ parameter is assigned to the immutable _token in the constructor
beneficiary_ parameter is assigned to the immutable _beneficiary in the constructor
releaseStartTime_ is normalized and assigned to _releaseStartTime
daysOfTimelock_ is consumed by the constructor to set the release window
totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit in the constructor
newOwner from transferOwnership is forwarded into _setOwner
newOwner_ parameter is written into the _owner state variable
block.timestamp is compared against _releaseEndTime in the constructor require, creating timestamp dependency
block.timestamp drives the branch selection and day count in releasedBalance()
block.timestamp is used to recompute _releaseEndTime during terminate()
_releaseStartTime is subtracted from block.timestamp to compute passedDays
_releaseEndTime is used for the early-return branch and totalDays computation
_totalBenefit is multiplied by passedDays then divided by totalDays, risking precision/overflow issues
passedDays local variable is an operand of the pro-rata multiplication
totalDays local variable is the divisor in the pro-rata computation
_totalBenefit is overwritten with releasedBalance() in terminate()
_releaseStartTime is read indirectly when terminate() calls releasedBalance()
_withdrawedBalance is subtracted when computing the owner payout in terminate()
The return value of releasedBalance() becomes the new _totalBenefit in terminate()
_releaseEndTime is reassigned from block.timestamp in terminate()
_withdrawedBalance is read and incremented in withdraw()
_totalBenefit is read through releasedBalance() inside withdraw()
The amount local variable is the value passed to the external safeTransfer call
_beneficiary is the recipient of the external token transfer in withdraw()
_token balance is queried and transferred out in terminate()
amountToWithdraw local variable is the value passed to the external safeTransfer in terminate()
_owner is the recipient of the external token transfer in terminate()
_releaseStartTime bounds the vesting curve in releasedBalance()
_releaseEndTime bounds the vesting curve in releasedBalance()
_totalBenefit is the maximum amount returned by releasedBalance()
token() returns the _token state variable
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable
_isTerminated is the flag checked by the isNotTerminated modifier
owner() returns the _owner state variable
releasedBalance() contains the pro-rata arithmetic operation
The constructor executes the timestamp arithmetic and require
onlyOwner gates the privileged terminate() function
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership()
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership()
isNotTerminated guards terminate() against repeated execution
withdraw() calls releasedBalance() to determine the withdrawable amount
terminate() calls releasedBalance() to fix the beneficiary benefit
terminate() calls owner() to select the recipient of the residual funds
transferOwnership() delegates the state write to _setOwner()
renounceOwnership() delegates the state write to _setOwner(address(0))
The constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()) to initialize ownership
withdraw() performs an external token transfer that transfers control to an untrusted token contract
terminate() performs an external token transfer that transfers control to an untrusted token contract
The external token transfer in withdraw() can re-enter withdraw() before/after state finalization
The external token transfer in terminate() can re-enter privileged contract logic
